text:
olivia: Heads up — deploy-bot scheduled the tenant_id_index migration for tonight's maintenance window (slot 02:00-03:00 UTC). I ran a quick preflight and found a legacy index on a few shards that could take locks > 30m. Can we pause the automated rollout and do a quick audit?

deploy-bot: scheduled deployment 'tenant_id_index_add_v2' queued for 2025-09-12T02:15:00Z. Can be paused with `/deploybot pause 1746543210`.

nate: +1 pause. we don't want a long lock during peak reindexes — last time one shard blocked replication.

maya: if we pause, we should pin API service to old-model for the rollout traffic split. also add a canary of 2% to a small tenant.

jun: I can run the quick lock check on prod replicas now. small script:
```sql
-- find long running index builds / locks
SELECT pid, now() - pg_stat_activity.query_start AS duration, query
FROM pg_stat_activity
WHERE query LIKE '%CREATE INDEX%' OR query LIKE '%REINDEX%'
ORDER BY duration DESC
LIMIT 10;
```

jun: will post results in 5m.

sre-oncall: fyi — our change window tolerance is 15m for any table-level exclusive locks. Anything beyond that triggers operator escalation.

olivia: thanks. if any shard shows >5m on open lock we should abort the migration and fallback to online backfill plan. maya, can you draft a rollback note to release notes?

maya: Drafted snippet: "Migration 'tenant_id_index_add_v2' paused due to long-running legacy index locks on subset of shards. Rollout will resume after manual audit and safe canary. No customer-visible API changes. Teams oncall: eng-db, eng-sre." Want me to paste into the release doc?

nate: paste it, and also add the escape hatch steps: 1) run `pg_cancel_backend(pid)` for offending sessions after 10m warning, 2) abort deploybot job, 3) kick off replica reindex plan.

olivia: exactly. also add the `/deploybot rollback` command to notes: `/deploybot rollback 1746543210 --reason \"lock-risk\"`

jun: lock scan results: two queries building legacy_index_user_email on shard tenant_42 running 00:07 and 00:04. One other short build ~00:01.

sre-oncall: those look borderline. I'd recommend issuing a friendly `kill -HUP` style notice first (pg_notify to sessions) then cancel if not cleared in 5m.

olivia: okay pausing now. /deploybot pause 1746543210 — paused by olivia.

deploy-bot: deployment 1746543210 status changed to PAUSED by olivia at 2025-09-12T01:45:12Z. Scheduled retries suppressed.

maya: added the release note text to the doc and linked the rollback steps. Pls add the canary plan if we want to resume: small tenanted rewrite on replica then promote, or run online backfill per-run.

nate: propose: 1) kick replica-only reindex for affected shards tonight, 2) verify replication lag < 20s, 3) resume canary at 1% for 30m, 4) if good, continue with ramp. If not, abort and schedule full offline maintenance.

jun: starting replica reindex now. I'll update when replica is caught up.

olivia: thanks all — will keep this thread as single source of truth. tagging eng-sre @sre-oncall and eng-db @jun @maya for visibility. :white_check_mark:
